snippet.title: Remote Realms Trailer
snippet.description:
Remote Realms is a free-to-play retro inspired MMORPG with charming graphics and quirky storylines. Start playing now: remoterealms.com

An awesome player made showcase of the sailing skill: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LJOuOO2jEP0

Besides the traditional point-and-click action Remote Realms brings you a fully player driven economy along with some cool skills like sailing and trainer. The different aspects of the game are designed to be highly interconnected and to have roles that stay relevant throughout the game. Skilling is the primary way of providing resources/goods into the game. The combat utilizes a type system that highly incentives the player to learn about various strengths and weaknesses presented by the different circumstances and the participants of a matchup. All in all, these design choices create a game where there is a lot of room to build strategies on how to play. There is no single answer to what is the best way to level your character or what is the best in slot gear setup. Everything depends on the conditions you find yourself in and where you want to go from there. Ultimately the best way to play Remote Realms is at your own pace in the way you think is the most fun. This game takes an insanely long time to fully complete after all.

If you prefer to get into the rhythm at a quicker pace, there is an awesome community of players having created a wiki about the game. These champions usually hangout in the discord server where you are more than welcome to ask questions!

Official website: remoterealms.com
